description: Mission environments for Galley. Drives who is notified and how the app behaves for escalation level >= 3.

one_way_delay_s.note: Near real time; loss-of-signal gaps occur

evacuation.en: Possible in days (Crew-11 precedent: decision 8-Jan-2026, splashdown 15-Jan-2026)
evacuation.es: Posible en días (precedente Crew-11: decisión 8-ene-2026, amerizaje 15-ene-2026)

behavior_level3.en: Notify the flight surgeon now (private medical conference).
behavior_level3.es: Avisar ahora al cirujano de vuelo (conferencia médica privada).

radiation_background.source: Di Fino et al. 2023, Life Sci Space Res 39:26-42 (ASI, LIDAL detector, Columbus 2020-2022): 1.8-2.4 nGy/s

evacuation.en: Return to Earth takes several days
evacuation.es: El regreso a la Tierra toma varios días

behavior_level3.en: Notify flight surgeon (near real time) and start on-board protocol.
behavior_level3.es: Avisar al cirujano de vuelo (casi en tiempo real) e iniciar el protocolo de a bordo.

radiation_background.source: Zhang et al. 2020, Sci Adv 6:eaaz1334 (Chang'e-4 LND, 1369 uSv/day)

one_way_delay_s.note: 3-22 min one way; up to ~44 min round trip; ~2-week blackout at solar conjunction every ~26 months

evacuation.en: Not possible — crew must act autonomously
evacuation.es: No es posible — la tripulación actúa de forma autónoma

behavior_level3.en: Follow the guided on-board protocol now. S-B-A-R report queued for Earth; reply expected in ~{minutes} min.
behavior_level3.es: Sigue ahora el protocolo guiado de a bordo. Reporte S-B-A-R en cola para la Tierra; respuesta estimada en ~{minutes} min.

cruise.source: Zeitlin et al. 2013, Science 340:1080-1084 (MSL RAD in transit)

surface.source: Hassler et al. 2014, Science 343:1244797 (MSL RAD, Gale crater)

references.delays: NASA NTRS — Communication Delays, Disruptions, and Blackouts for Crewed Mars Missions (ASCEND)
references.crew11: NPR, 15-Jan-2026 — Crew-11 returns a month early after first ISS medical evacuation
